body:
PR #163 preserved useful fighter identity but mapped it into insufficient submission opportunity. This audit identifies coupled entry/occupancy/activity inconsistencies without training or selecting a replacement model.

Starting main: 54a0b647825295b09342fa02cca4f40210bf4f94. PR #162 excluded. Primary classification: **E — multiple measurement-to-hazard errors are material**, centered on opportunity mapping. The single-state stationary inversion does not conserve bilateral occupancy; total-time TD access is additionally gated by standing; decision-only CTRL and all-history activity do not share opportunity semantics.

| Diagnostic | Conditional LL | Brier | Full SUB |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Arm C | 0.607777 | 0.210100 | 16.23% |
| Frozen primary | 0.627949 | 0.217752 | 12.74% |
| Training occupancy proxy oracle | 0.610802 | 0.211629 | 17.69% |
| Training attempt-frequency oracle | 0.608726 | 0.210554 | 17.93% |
| Training conversion oracle | 0.625456 | 0.217339 | 12.90% |
| Combined submission-process oracle | 0.608541 | 0.210519 | 18.16% |

Oracles are target-independent training aggregate diagnostics, not deployable models. Most CTRL occupancy targets are physically infeasible under the frozen entry/reset chain. Attempt and conversion hazard sweeps are observationally identical at equal factors; support and action rewards distinguish stages. Conversion shrinkage removes 99.69% of raw within-division/year variance but explains little aggregate deficit.

B3/B5 retain stronger identity before hazard conversion; attempt oracle raises conditional SUB to 47.12%/51.95%. A1/A4 recover, but A2 is damaged. Only 2021 improves in the frozen primary versus Arm C; every support stratum remains worse. No oracle beats Arm C overall.

Read **NEXT_POC_DECISION.md**, **MEASUREMENT_TO_HAZARD_MATRIX.md**, and **HOLMES_UFC_EDGE_COMPONENT_COMPARISON.md** under `docs/model_diagnostics/ground_pathway_measurement_hazard_v1`. Includes all 18 requested reports, fixed single-component curves, exact per-fight reward records, training-only oracle support/factors, source hashes, preregistration proof and completion marker.

Validation: exact 4260 fight identity match; frozen PR163 manifest independently reproduced; baseline/half/double probabilities within 9e-15; independent quadrature within 3.4e-14; actor swap, normalization, invalid-hazard rejection and one-second propagation checks; two full runs with 24 byte-identical artifacts. Git diff is additive audit-only. CI verifies archive and frozen source evidence.

Exact next milestone: **UFC_EDGE_GROUND_OPPORTUNITY_REWARD_CONSISTENCY_CONTRACT_V1**, a training-only measurement/state contract before any second POC. No recommended numeric factor, model promotion, F01/F02 change, prospective outcome access, or automatic merge.

Evidence manifest SHA256: `677556ef4195474218bb8bcd62de82402ef8bd6f31e528fc7cf816a7f921dd31`.

Validation CI passed on evidence head `edc831a46be1d6b48e1fa36ea6eb2507b3bdbc21`: https://github.com/Tkcool28/ufc-edge/actions/runs/37973633678 . Remote/local Git trees match exactly. PR remains draft; main remains the starting SHA.
